head: 2a799d5f8b9f47838d0f40b2adf3f65412196426
claim: An app can pass a launch on a bot's spec so the kit runs Pi inside the app's own wall at every start: Pi answers from inside a real bubblewrap wall with the same argv it gets with no launch and cannot see a file outside the wall, and a launch that throws or a missing wall command starts nothing.

runs.command: npx tsc -b packages/pi > "$DONE_DONE_EVIDENCE_ROOT/build.log" 2>&1 && sh scripts/test.sh 'packages/pi/test/*.test.ts' > "$DONE_DONE_EVIDENCE_ROOT/pi-tests.log" 2>&1 && node .agents/skills/done-done-verify-byokit/capture/pi-launch.mjs

steps.start: A built checkout, a bot with its own folder and Pi home, a file outside them, and a loopback stand-in model
steps: Run a bot with no launch and read the argv Pi got
Run the same bot with a launch that puts Pi in a bubblewrap sandbox
Kill the walled process and send another message
Start a bot whose launch throws, then one whose command is missing
steps.result: Pi answered from inside the wall with the same argv and could not see or write the outside file, came back inside it after a crash, and a throwing launch or a missing wall started nothing

verdicts.seen: Read the whole capture (no-launch, launch, crash, stop, throwing launch, missing wall, model-asked lines). Launch line: text "behind the wall", process bwrap, "launch got the same argv as no launch: true", "Pi sees the outside file: false", "its write reached the real disk: false". The no-launch baseline shows the outside file visible and the write reaching disk. The crash line shows a restart: "back behind it" and "launch ran 2 times". The stop line shows "the walled process is gone in 10 ms". The throwing launch gives "bad-launch: ... its launch failed" with "process: undefined". The missing wall gives "pi-exited: ... ENOENT" with "process: undefined". "the model was asked nothing by either refused start: true". Every clause of the outcome is shown and nothing contradicts it.
